priorityDecision.S04-002: Do not repeat exhausted source attempts. Original 2025 report lacks 2010-2014 capacity and exact unrounded complete costs. The already-retained 2026 PxWeb country table has 119/113/104/96/91 missing country cells in 2010-2014, so subtotals are not a certified global onshore series. Exact installed-cost table remains absent. No fit, interpolation, vintage splice or shortened window.
priorityDecision.S04-003_and_S05: Native 2024 EDGAR/GCB aggregate accounting does not independently establish signed five-region land-use allocation and matched international transport accounts. No invented allocation or driver calibration; these original gaps remain unchanged.
priorityDecision.selectedPermittedFallback: Acquire and assemble actual source-native HadCRUT5.1 200-member GMST observations explicitly used by the operative IGCC-2025 GWI preset. This closes a previously located-but-not-downloaded observation dependency, not the source-control/forcing/native-emissions dependencies.

resources.finding: Defines global blended near-surface temperature anomalies relative 1961-1990, identifies HadCRUT5 as Met Office/CRU collaboration, declares OGLv3 and explicitly requires reading linked terms. Current official release is 5.2.0.0; it is NOT substituted for the operative 5.1.0.0 snapshot.

Dataset-specific HadCRUT5 Crown copyright and Open Government Licence v3; Morice et al. doi:10.1029/2019JD032361 citation and prescribed acknowledgement required. Read before acquiring observation bytes, fulfilling the landing page's express terms instruction.

resources.vintageCaveat: This is the exact operative author snapshot, independently matching the already-located git blob identity. It is not claimed to be the latest official release or byte-certified original Met Office publication. Original release day and information available at historical origins remain unknown; HTTP date and hash do not establish them.

newAcquisition.rightsBoundary: HadCRUT5-specific OGLv3 applies to these observations, not to unfetched CMIP6 controls or all GWI ancillary data. Native observations and derived members are retained privately; no publication or redistribution performed. Required acknowledgement must retain truthful author-repository acquisition and must not invent the unknown original-version first-publication year.

implementation.inputForFutureGWIConstraint: actual-gmst-observation-members.nc:native_gmst_anomaly, dimensions year/observation_member. The existing GWI kernel applies its own common baseline. gmst_anomaly is the separately retained, already-rebased diagnostic; do not individually member-rebase it.
gates: Pinned source/protocol/terms/operative-definition hashes and exact native git blob SHA-1
Exact ordered 200-realization header; duplicates, summaries and missing fields rejected
Complete unique integer 1850-2025 annual years, no missing/nonfinite input or endpoint extension
Optional 2026 source row retained in raw bytes and explicitly excluded from annual observations
Coverage fraction in [0,1] and nonnegative coverage uncertainty; separate uncertainty column never treated as member or silently sampled
Independent numerical common-offset calculation and between-member-difference preservation
NetCDF readback equality against assembled native and centered arrays

initialFailurePreserved.failure: Two renamed/duplicate-header assertions initially failed because fixture() reused and mutated the imported HEADER list. Corrected fixture to HEADER.copy(); strict parser gates unchanged. Actual source assembly was not attempted until corrected tests passed.

actualNewSourceChecks.unit: degrees Celsius, global blended GMST anomaly
actualNewSourceChecks.sourceDefinedRebase: One 1850-1900 inclusive mean of annual ensemble medians, common to all 200 members
actualNewSourceChecks.uncertaintyQualification: These are real native observation realizations, not synthetic calibrated climate members. Coverage uncertainty remains an explicit separate source field; the assembly does not claim that the operative GWI realization-only treatment includes every observational uncertainty.
actualNewSourceChecks.precisionQualification: Digits document deterministic source transformation and roundoff, not observational accuracy.
